model_annotation: This grouped bar chart illustrates average percentage values ("Durchschnitte in %") for four economic indicators across three decade-based time periods. The horizontal axis displays three categorical groups: "2000er Jahre," "2010er Jahre," and "2020er Jahre," representing the 2000s, 2010s, and 2020s respectively. The vertical axis shows percentage values on a linear scale ranging from -2.0 to 6.0, with tick marks at intervals of 1.0 percentage point. Each time period contains four bars representing four indicators as identified in the legend: "Welt-BIP" (World GDP) shown in dark green, "Welthandel" (World Trade) shown in light green, "Exporte Deutschland" (German Exports) shown in dark blue, and "Industrieproduktion Deutschland" (German Industrial Production) shown in light blue. For the 2000er Jahre group, Welt-BIP reaches 3.9%, Welthandel reaches 5.4%, Exporte Deutschland reaches 5.3%, and Industrieproduktion Deutschland reaches 1.0%. For the 2010er Jahre group, Welt-BIP is at 3.7%, Welthandel at 4.8%, Exporte Deutschland at 5.0%, and Industrieproduktion Deutschland at 2.2%. For the 2020er Jahre group, Welt-BIP is at 2.7%, Welthandel at 2.3%, Exporte Deutschland at 0.4%, and Industrieproduktion Deutschland extends below zero to -1.5%. Each bar is annotated with its exact value displayed above (or below, in the case of the negative value) the bar. The bars within each group are arranged in the consistent order of Welt-BIP, Welthandel, Exporte Deutschland, and Industrieproduktion Deutschland from left to right, and no bars appear to be visually emphasized through bolding or outlining beyond their distinct color coding.
